title: Quantifier bits match level bits
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $r$, replace each existential quantifier in the level quantifier list of width $w$ and depth $r$ by true and each universal quantifier by false. The resulting bit list is exactly the level bit list of width $w$ and depth $r$.
